messages:
tara: Quick FYI — UX sync tomorrow to decide how Console surfaces per-route sampling. I'm leaning toward an inline slider for quick canary tweaks and a small "PII exposure estimate" metric next to the rate. Thoughts?
julian: +1 to slider. For metrics show both sample-rate (%) and sampled_count (24h). PII exposure needs to be clearly heuristic.
hana: If we surface PII exposure, include a confidence band and a short explainer. Legal will object if it looks authoritative.
kevin: Implementation idea: compute pii_exposure_estimate = sampled_tokens * pii_risk_score; show as label like "Estimate: 120 tokens (low)" and hover to show formula. Also add immutable provenance header: `X-Redwood-Sample: route=checkout;rate=0.02;seed=abc123` so downstream tooling can tie samples back to config.
maria: For UX, should the slider write directly to the route config or open a modal? Inline is great for fast iteration but we need an audit trail on changes.
tara: inline slider with confirm modal for >2x increases. capture actor+reason in audit log.
julian: Also include a small last-change actor next to the badge (e.g., "0.5% — changed by @maria 2h ago").
hana: Redaction policy: default redact_sampled=true. Unmask/unredacted views require an audited request (reason, TTL, audit_id) and are logged as `sampling.unredacted_view`.
kevin: Telemetry events we should emit:
- `sampling.rule.applied` (route, rate, actor, change_id)
- `sampling.sampled_event` (route, trace_id, sample_header, pii_risk_score, tokens_sampled)
- `sampling.unredacted_view` (actor, route, audit_id, ttl)
These allow the Console to show sampled counts and alert on spikes.
maria: Important: sampled tokens should only decrement inspect/unmask quota when someone requests unredacted view. Otherwise they count against billing tokens only.
infra: One perf concern: we run lightweight heuristics to compute pii_risk_score pre-redaction. That adds CPU on the hot path. Consider caching by prompt-hash or doing heuristics async for heavy routes.
kevin: We can use salted hashes for prompt snippets in telemetry for dedupe. Salt kept per-tenant and rotated on a schedule.
hana: Legal wants a short playbook for temporary unmask access: who can approve, TTL max 24h, reason required, and all unmasked views stored with audit_id. Also require redact_rules default and tenant override policy.
julian: UX microcopy suggestion: "Estimated PII exposure — heuristics-based. Not legal advice. Click for methodology & provenance." Link to playbook.
kevin: Example config snippet to show in Console docs and export to infra yaml:
```
sampling:
  mode: per-route
  strategy: probabilistic
  rate: 0.005
  redact_sampled: true
  redact_rules:
    - email
    - credit_card
    - ssn
  provenance_header: "X-Redwood-Sample"
  tenant_overrides: true
```
maria: redact_rules should have allowlist vs blocklist modes and be editable per-tenant with defaults per-org.
tara: Dashboard layout idea: three columns — (1) sample-rate badge + last-change actor, (2) sampled_count (24h) + sparkline, (3) PII exposure estimate with confidence band and link to provenance.
kevin: Add `sampling.rule.applied` event to the audit log so we can track who changed rates and why. Also emit `sampling.rule.eval_skipped` if heuristics were deferred.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Staging preview for sampling-ux available at https://staging.console.redwood.test/sampling-ux (expires in 7d)
maria: Banner idea: show a non-dismissable small banner when any sample-rate > 0: "Some requests for this route may be captured for debugging. Content will be redacted unless unmask is audited." with link to settings.
hana: For temporary unmask flow include TTL and automatic revoke, plus mandatory reason field and approver identity. Store audit_id in telemetry for traceability.
kevin: Rollout plan: default redact_sampled=true for all tenants. Opt-in unmask via enterprise policy. Start with internal tenants and a small canary.
julian: Also show provenance header in sampled-event rows so the eval team can filter by seed/decision. Helpful for reproducing flaky cases.
infra: Action items:
- kevin: add provenance header and telemetry events (ETA Tue)
- julian + maria: designs for inline slider, confirm modal, and banner (ETA Wed)
- hana: legal playbook draft for unmask + TTL + approver flow (ETA Thu)
- infra: perf estimate for running heuristics on hot path and caching options (PR)
- tara: draft short RFC that ties UI, telemetry, and audit requirements together (ETA Fri)
maria: One more Q — should we include a hashed prompt snippet in `sampling.sampled_event`? hashed with tenant salt only so content not reversible.
kevin: yes hashed snippet helps dedupe. Ensure salt rotation policy and document in playbook.

tara: Thanks all — I'll collect notes and spin up the RFC. :thumbsup:
